description: Airing schedule for a season or upcoming episode window. "season" mode returns all anime airing in a given season/year. "upcoming" mode returns next episode for airing titles within a date window, with UTC timestamps.

days_ahead.description: Days ahead to look for upcoming episodes, 1–30. Mode "upcoming" only (rejected with mode "season"); 7 when omitted.

mode.description: "season": all anime from a specific season/year. Requires season and season_year. "upcoming": next airing episode for each currently-airing title within days_ahead window.

page.description: 1-based page number. AniList serves only the first 5,000 entries of a list, so page × per_page must stay at or below 5,000.

per_page.description: Results per page. Maximum 50; page × per_page must stay at or below 5,000.

anyOf.description: Anime broadcast season. WINTER=Jan–Mar, SPRING=Apr–Jun, SUMMER=Jul–Sep, FALL=Oct–Dec.

season.description: Season to list. Required with mode "season"; rejected with mode "upcoming".

season_year.description: 4-digit year. Required with mode "season"; rejected with mode "upcoming".

name: anime_get_schedule

next_airing_at_utc.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of next airing, or null.

next_episode.description: Next episode number, or null if not currently airing.

time_until_airing_seconds.description: Seconds until next airing, or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_season`: mode is "season" but season or season_year is missing. `conflicting_inputs`: mode "upcoming" is sent with season or season_year, or mode "season" with days_ahead. `page_depth_exceeded`: page × per_page reaches past the first 5,000 entries, which AniList refuses to serve. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages are available. Drives pagination; stop when false.

notice.description: Set when entries is empty — echoes the applied mode/season and how to broaden it, says the page is past the end of the list, or (upcoming mode) says every episode on the page was an adult title hidden by include_adult. Also set on the last season page AniList serves (its 5,000-entry reach) while has_next_page is still true.

season_label.description: Human-readable season label, e.g. "FALL 2024", or null for upcoming mode.

totalCount.description: Exact number of titles in the season, set only on its final page (0 for an empty first page); season mode only. Use has_next_page to paginate.

total_results.description: Exact number of titles in the season, present only on its final page (has_next_page false) and 0 for an empty first page. Null on every other page and always null in upcoming mode.

title: Anime Get Schedule
